nightPlans.summary: Night plans are bundles that are only valid during set hours, usually overnight. Check the time window and the validity period on the bundle details before buying.
tips: Download large files and updates in the night window.
Check whether the bundle is valid on your device and in your state.
Buy one day at a time if you are not sure about the rules.

airtimeToCash.summary: Airtime-to-cash rates change constantly and vary by network and platform. Many quotes fall between 60% and 80% of face value. Treat any rate as indicative until you confirm it.
warnings: Never send airtime to someone you have not met to 'unlock' a payout.
Use only platforms that show a clear rate before you send.
